title: PUT /books/{id} is full-replace, requires title+author
evidence: app.py:66-82 update_book calls _validate_book which mandates title and author; no PATCH/partial update
suggestion: Optional: support partial updates or a PATCH verb; spec only requires update, so acceptable

title: Module-level create_app() opens/creates the DB at import time
evidence: app.py:165 app = create_app() runs init_db() and mkdir on import
suggestion: Optional: defer DB init behind __main__ or an app-factory entrypoint to avoid import side effects
